He said something about behind him...
There's a chair... I guess I sit in it?
I know this isn't the time for, well, this.
Bear with me a little longer, please.
For now, let's try sitting in that chair...
But I'm not leaving this place
Undergo the trial, hero of Fire...
That just now — Win, was that you?
Like... a voice of the trial...?

Does the trial begin when
I sit in this chair...?

That armor earlier really
seemed like the trial, but...
this seems to be the real thing...
Since we don't know what'll happen,
Huh... no way... it can't be...
For real... that voice... that voice is...

it's big bro's... Homura's
voice, isn't it...
Win! Is he there — is my big bro...!
For some reason, Win can't move at all!
Hono, I wanted to see you.
There was so much I still wanted to tell you...
Is the trial about meeting the dead!?
What happens in the trial is a secret.
Which is why only the king ever knows the truth...

...But never in my
wildest dreams did I think
I'd end up talking with you, big bro...
That's right — what you don't understand, Hono,
I likely don't understand either, nor anyone.
Praising me in that baffling way—

Saying 'for real, for real' so
much is just like you, Hono.
I always wanted to become like you,

Admired by all as a fine
man, like you were...
So it was so hard after you died.
I tried reading lots of books.
I even tried speaking politely to everyone.
I was really looking forward to you—
so kind and smart, more than anyone—
When they saw me imitating you...
everyone was all the more disappointed...

No matter how much I read,
nothing stuck in my head...
I couldn't even manage polite speech...
In the end, I just ended up pathetic.
Yeah... I could never become him...
What'll you do once I'm back?
I'll come back to life and properly become king.
If you pass your crest to me,
It'll be the world you've always wanted...
I'll become king and make this country better...
This is a passageway for dead souls...
Here, one can pass a crest to the dead and revive them.
Come on, think it over, Hono...

...If Homura had become
king and made this country
Then I'd just swing my sword around
Yes, that was the future I'd wished for...
That future is within reach, Hono.
Come, pass the crest to me.
And let's make both our dreams come true.
Win tried to shout, but no voice came out.

I actually thought you
might be the real him!!
Even my 'for real, for real' tic that I'm
the real him would never say it suits me,
he never wanted to be king...
So if you were really him...
you'd never say you want to be king!!
How'd I do on the trial?
Sorry for dragging you through that...

Come on, let's go get
scolded by the old man!
